product.title: Ivory Linen Family Matching Set - Vest, Shirt & Shorts
product.descriptionHtml:
• Fabric: Lightweight ivory linen-look woven fabric; exact fiber content was not visible from the blocked vendor page.
  • Family story: A clean family matching look for moms, dads, girls, and boys in soft vacation ivory.
  • Color: Solid ivory pieces designed to coordinate without a busy print.
  • Design details: Girls and moms wear the button-front vest; boys and dads wear the camp-collar shirt or matching shorts. Hats, jewelry, bags, sunglasses, and shoes are styling only.
  • Care: Machine wash cold on gentle, line dry, do not bleach, and steam or cool iron inside-out if needed.
  • Size range: Child 2 Years through Child 9-10 Years, Mother S-3XL, and Father S-4XL.

Fit Guide

Kids sizes are based on the child's actual height: 90cm is about ages 1-2, 100cm about ages 2-3, 110cm about ages 4-5, 120cm about ages 5-6, 130cm about ages 7-8, 140cm about ages 9-10, and 150cm about ages 11-12. Adult sizing follows typical 1688 Asian sizing and tends to run small, so we recommend sizing up one from your usual US/EU size.

Adult fit estimate: S fits about 155-160cm / 45-50kg, M fits 160-165cm / 50-55kg, L fits 165-170cm / 55-62kg, XL fits 170-175cm / 62-70kg, 2XL fits 175-178cm / 70-78kg, 3XL fits 178-182cm / 78-88kg, and 4XL fits 180-185cm / 88-95kg where that adult size is available.

Ivory Linen keeps family dressing relaxed and bright, with separates that look polished for vacation photos, resort dinners, and sunny weekends. The vest option is chart-backed for girls and moms, while shirts and shorts are chart-backed for boys and dads.

Choose the Type and Size for each family member to build the exact matching look you need. Every live variant is backed by the attached vendor size chart, and styling-only accessories are intentionally excluded.

Key Features:

  • Three garment options: Vest, Shirt, and Shorts in one coordinated family listing.
  • Soft ivory palette: Easy to style for beach, cruise, and warm-weather family photos.
  • Role-bearing sizing: Size labels clearly separate child, mother, and father rows.
  • Chart-backed variants: Only size rows visible in the supplied chart were created.
  • Lightweight feel: Linen-look texture gives the pieces an airy summer finish.

Select each vest, shirt, or shorts size to create a crisp matching moment for the whole family.
